# Google Maps place saving app (2025-12-06 07:46Z)

_**User (2025-12-06 07:09Z)**_

The idea is to get places from google maps to our app like restaurant, coffee shop, parcs, etc.



With this data in our database, we will be able to filter, show a nicer view of every entity we save in our database, create private and public list that we will be able to share with other people. There will also be a Wheel of places (you select X places and put it in the wheel, then it will randomly shows you a place to go ). 

The user can add places from google maps to our database via a maps that is integrated into our website. 

On click of a marker, it will shows the detail of that place then ask the user if he want to save it in the app. 

When the map load, we should show all the marker of the user. 

When we load the website, we should have first a landing page showing the merit of our app and on the top a signin button. (Look at the screenshot with GmapsPlus in a bigl title for some inspiration) 

When we click on signin - we load a sign in page with the ability to register also. (basic email and password) 

once we logged we are on our logged area where we will be able to see our list of entity, our lists (public and shared) and a link to the wheel of places.

I’ve linked mockup of the app - those are mockups don't follow the colors etc but try to do something modern with Shadcn components.

_**User (2025-12-06 07:09Z)**_

I want even more fields than that from Google maps detail api, when you'll do the call to google places api you cn specific a wildcards a fieldmask (*) and so you'll have more stuff. 

Also, I don't want a user to be a owner of a places, I would prefer another table that link a place to a user and so when we "want" to add a new places, we could just look if it's there in the table first so we don't have to do a query to the place api that cost a lot of money.

```diff
+ import { action } from "./_generated/server";
+ import { v } from "convex/values";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Fetch place details from Google Places API using fieldMask: "*" to get all fields
+  */
+ export const fetchPlaceDetails = action({
+   args: {
+     placeId: v.string(),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const apiKey = process.env.GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY;
+     if (!apiKey) {
+       throw new Error("GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY environment variable is not set");
+     }
+ 
+     const url = new URL("https://places.googleapis.com/v1/places/" + args.placeId);
+     url.searchParams.append("key", apiKey);
+     url.searchParams.append("languageCode", "en");
+ 
+     // Use fieldMask: "*" to get all available fields
+     const response = await fetch(url.toString(), {
+       method: "GET",
+       headers: {
+         "Content-Type": "application/json",
+         "X-Goog-FieldMask": "*",
+       },
+     });
+ 
+     if (!response.ok) {
+       const errorText = await response.text();
+       throw new Error(
+         &#96;Google Places API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} - ${errorText}&#96;
+       );
+     }
+ 
+     const data = await response.json();
+     return data;
+   },
+ });
+ 
```

```diff
+ import { query, mutation } from "./_generated/server";
+ import { v } from "convex/values";
+ import { getAuthUserId } from "@convex-dev/auth/server";
+ import { api } from "./_generated/api";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Save a place to the database. First checks if place exists by googlePlaceId.
+  * If it exists, just creates the userPlaces link. If not, fetches from API and saves.
+  */
+ export const savePlace = mutation({
+   args: {
+     googlePlaceId: v.string(),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       throw new Error("Not authenticated");
+     }
+ 
+     // Check if place already exists in our database
+     const existingPlace = await ctx.db
+       .query("places")
+       .withIndex("by_googlePlaceId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("googlePlaceId", args.googlePlaceId))
+       .first();
+ 
+     let placeId;
+     if (existingPlace) {
+       // Place exists, just use it
+       placeId = existingPlace._id;
+     } else {
+       // Place doesn't exist, fetch from Google Places API
+       const placeData = await ctx.runAction(api.googlePlaces.fetchPlaceDetails, {
+         placeId: args.googlePlaceId,
+       });
+ 
+       // Save the place to database
+       placeId = await ctx.db.insert("places", {
+         googlePlaceId: args.googlePlaceId,
+         data: placeData,
+         createdAt: Date.now(),
+         updatedAt: Date.now(),
+       });
+     }
+ 
+     // Check if user already has this place saved
+     const existingUserPlace = await ctx.db
+       .query("userPlaces")
+       .withIndex("by_userId_placeId", (q) =&gt;
+         q.eq("userId", userId).eq("placeId", placeId)
+       )
+       .first();
+ 
+     if (existingUserPlace) {
+       // User already has this place saved
+       return { placeId, alreadySaved: true };
+     }
+ 
+     // Create userPlaces link
+     await ctx.db.insert("userPlaces", {
+       userId,
+       placeId,
+       savedAt: Date.now(),
+     });
+ 
+     return { placeId, alreadySaved: false };
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get all places saved by the current user
+  */
+ export const getUserPlaces = query({
+   args: {},
+   handler: async (ctx) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       return [];
+     }
+ 
+     const userPlaces = await ctx.db
+       .query("userPlaces")
+       .withIndex("by_userId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("userId", userId))
+       .collect();
+ 
+     // Fetch place details for each userPlace
+     const places = await Promise.all(
+       userPlaces.map(async (userPlace) =&gt; {
+         const place = await ctx.db.get(userPlace.placeId);
+         if (!place) {
+           return null;
+         }
+         return {
+           ...place,
+           savedAt: userPlace.savedAt,
+           userPlaceId: userPlace._id,
+         };
+       })
+     );
+ 
+     return places.filter((p) =&gt; p !== null);
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get place by ID
+  */
+ export const getPlaceById = query({
+   args: {
+     placeId: v.id("places"),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     return await ctx.db.get(args.placeId);
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Remove a saved place from user's collection
+  */
+ export const removePlace = mutation({
+   args: {
+     userPlaceId: v.id("userPlaces"),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       throw new Error("Not authenticated");
+     }
+ 
+     const userPlace = await ctx.db.get(args.userPlaceId);
+     if (!userPlace || userPlace.userId !== userId) {
+       throw new Error("User place not found or not owned by user");
+     }
+ 
+     await ctx.db.delete(args.userPlaceId);
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Search/filter user's places
+  */
+ export const searchPlaces = query({
+   args: {
+     searchQuery: v.optional(v.string()),
+     type: v.optional(v.string()),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       return [];
+     }
+ 
+     const userPlaces = await ctx.db
+       .query("userPlaces")
+       .withIndex("by_userId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("userId", userId))
+       .collect();
+ 
+     const places = await Promise.all(
+       userPlaces.map(async (userPlace) =&gt; {
+         const place = await ctx.db.get(userPlace.placeId);
+         if (!place) {
+           return null;
+         }
+         return {
+           ...place,
+           savedAt: userPlace.savedAt,
+           userPlaceId: userPlace._id,
+         };
+       })
+     );
+ 
+     let filtered = places.filter((p) =&gt; p !== null);
+ 
+     // Filter by search query
+     if (args.searchQuery) {
+       const query = args.searchQuery.toLowerCase();
+       filtered = filtered.filter((place) =&gt; {
+         const name = place?.data?.displayName?.text?.toLowerCase() || "";
+         const address = place?.data?.formattedAddress?.toLowerCase() || "";
+         return name.includes(query) || address.includes(query);
+       });
+     }
+ 
+     // Filter by type
+     if (args.type) {
+       filtered = filtered.filter((place) =&gt; {
+         const types = place?.data?.types || [];
+         return types.includes(args.type);
+       });
+     }
+ 
+     return filtered;
+   },
+ });
+ 
```

```diff
+ import { query, mutation } from "./_generated/server";
+ import { v } from "convex/values";
+ import { getAuthUserId } from "@convex-dev/auth/server";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Create a new list
+  */
+ export const createList = mutation({
+   args: {
+     name: v.string(),
+     description: v.optional(v.string()),
+     isPublic: v.boolean(),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       throw new Error("Not authenticated");
+     }
+ 
+     const listId = await ctx.db.insert("lists", {
+       userId,
+       name: args.name,
+       description: args.description,
+       isPublic: args.isPublic,
+       shareToken: undefined,
+       createdAt: Date.now(),
+       updatedAt: Date.now(),
+     });
+ 
+     return listId;
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get all lists for the current user
+  */
+ export const getUserLists = query({
+   args: {},
+   handler: async (ctx) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       return [];
+     }
+ 
+     const lists = await ctx.db
+       .query("lists")
+       .withIndex("by_userId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("userId", userId))
+       .collect();
+ 
+     // Get place counts for each list
+     const listsWithCounts = await Promise.all(
+       lists.map(async (list) =&gt; {
+         const listPlaces = await ctx.db
+           .query("listPlaces")
+           .withIndex("by_listId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("listId", list._id))
+           .collect();
+ 
+         return {
+           ...list,
+           placeCount: listPlaces.length,
+         };
+       })
+     );
+ 
+     return listsWithCounts;
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Get list by ID with places
+  */
+ export const getListById = query({
+   args: {
+     listId: v.id("lists"),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       throw new Error("Not authenticated");
+     }
+ 
+     const list = await ctx.db.get(args.listId);
+     if (!list) {
+       return null;
+     }
+ 
+     // Check if user has access (owner or shared)
+     if (list.userId !== userId) {
+       const shared = await ctx.db
+         .query("sharedLists")
+         .withIndex("by_listId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("listId", args.listId))
+         .filter((q) =&gt; q.eq(q.field("userId"), userId))
+         .first();
+ 
+       if (!shared) {
+         throw new Error("List not found or access denied");
+       }
+     }
+ 
+     // Get places in the list
+     const listPlaces = await ctx.db
+       .query("listPlaces")
+       .withIndex("by_listId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("listId", args.listId))
+       .collect();
+ 
+     const places = await Promise.all(
+       listPlaces.map(async (listPlace) =&gt; {
+         const place = await ctx.db.get(listPlace.placeId);
+         return place ? { ...place, addedAt: listPlace.addedAt } : null;
+       })
+     );
+ 
+     return {
+       ...list,
+       places: places.filter((p) =&gt; p !== null),
+     };
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Update list details
+  */
+ export const updateList = mutation({
+   args: {
+     listId: v.id("lists"),
+     name: v.optional(v.string()),
+     description: v.optional(v.string()),
+     isPublic: v.optional(v.boolean()),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       throw new Error("Not authenticated");
+     }
+ 
+     const list = await ctx.db.get(args.listId);
+     if (!list || list.userId !== userId) {
+       throw new Error("List not found or not owned by user");
+     }
+ 
+     await ctx.db.patch(args.listId, {
+       name: args.name ?? list.name,
+       description: args.description ?? list.description,
+       isPublic: args.isPublic ?? list.isPublic,
+       updatedAt: Date.now(),
+     });
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Delete a list
+  */
+ export const deleteList = mutation({
+   args: {
+     listId: v.id("lists"),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       throw new Error("Not authenticated");
+     }
+ 
+     const list = await ctx.db.get(args.listId);
+     if (!list || list.userId !== userId) {
+       throw new Error("List not found or not owned by user");
+     }
+ 
+     // Delete all listPlaces entries
+     const listPlaces = await ctx.db
+       .query("listPlaces")
+       .withIndex("by_listId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("listId", args.listId))
+       .collect();
+ 
+     for (const listPlace of listPlaces) {
+       await ctx.db.delete(listPlace._id);
+     }
+ 
+     // Delete sharedLists entries
+     const sharedLists = await ctx.db
+       .query("sharedLists")
+       .withIndex("by_listId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("listId", args.listId))
+       .collect();
+ 
+     for (const sharedList of sharedLists) {
+       await ctx.db.delete(sharedList._id);
+     }
+ 
+     // Delete the list
+     await ctx.db.delete(args.listId);
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**
+  * Add a place to a list
+  */
+ export const addPlaceToList = mutation({
+   args: {
+     listId: v.id("lists"),
+     placeId: v.id("places"),
+   },
+   handler: async (ctx, args) =&gt; {
+     const userId = await getAuthUserId(ctx);
+     if (!userId) {
+       throw new Error("Not authenticated");
+     }
+ 
+     const list = await ctx.db.get(args.listId);
+     if (!list || list.userId !== userId) {
+       throw new Error("List not found or not owned by user");
+     }
+ 
+     // Check if place is already in list
+     const existing = await ctx.db
+       .query("listPlaces")
+       .withIndex("by_listId", (q) =&gt; q.eq("listId", args.listId))
+       .filter((q) =&gt; q.eq(q.field("placeId"), args.placeId))
+       .first();
+ 
+     if (existing) {
+       return; // Already in list
+     }
+ 
+     await ctx.db.insert("listPlaces", {
+       listId: args.listId,
+       placeId: args.placeId,
+       addedAt: Date.now(),
+     });
+ 
+     // Update list updatedAt
+     await ctx.db.patch(args.listId, {
+       updatedAt: Date.now(),
+     });
+   },
+ });
+ 
+ /**

+  */
+ export const removePlaceFromList = mutation({

+       .first();
+ 
+     if (listPlace) {

+     }
+ 
+     // Update list updatedAt

+     });
+   },

+ 
+ /**

+  */
+ export const generateShareToken = mutation({

+     if (!userId) {

+
```

```diff
+ import { useState } from "react";
+ import { useMutation, useQuery } from "convex/react";
+ import { api } from "../../convex/_generated/api";
+ import {
+   Dialog,
+   DialogContent,
+   DialogDescription,
+   DialogHeader,
+   DialogTitle,
+ } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
+ import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
+ import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
+ import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
+ import { Star, MapPin, Phone, Globe, Clock } from "lucide-react";
+ 
+ interface PlaceDetailsDialogProps {
+   placeId: string | null;
+   open: boolean;
+   onOpenChange: (open: boolean) =&gt; void;
+   onPlaceSaved?: () =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ export function PlaceDetailsDialog({
+   placeId,
+   open,
+   onOpenChange,
+   onPlaceSaved,
+ }: PlaceDetailsDialogProps) {
+   const [selectedListId, setSelectedListId] = useState&lt;string&gt;("");
+   const savePlace = useMutation(api.places.savePlace);
+   const removePlace = useMutation(api.places.removePlace);
+   const addPlaceToList = useMutation(api.lists.addPlaceToList);
+   const userPlaces = useQuery(api.places.getUserPlaces);
+   const userLists = useQuery(api.lists.getUserLists);
+   const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
+ 
+   // Find if this place is already saved
+   const savedPlace = userPlaces?.find(
+     (p) =&gt; p.data?.id === placeId || p.googlePlaceId === placeId
+   );
+ 
+   const handleSave = async () =&gt; {
+     if (!placeId) return;
+     setSaving(true);
+     try {
+       await savePlace({ googlePlaceId: placeId });
+       onPlaceSaved?.();
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error("Error saving place:", error);
+     } finally {
+       setSaving(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleRemove = async () =&gt; {
+     if (!savedPlace?.userPlaceId) return;
+     setSaving(true);
+     try {
+       await removePlace({ userPlaceId: savedPlace.userPlaceId });
+       onPlaceSaved?.();
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error("Error removing place:", error);
+     } finally {
+       setSaving(false);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleAddToList = async () =&gt; {
+     if (!selectedListId || !savedPlace?._id) return;
+     try {
+       await addPlaceToList({
+         listId: selectedListId as any,
+         placeId: savedPlace._id,
+       });
+       setSelectedListId("");
+     } catch (error) {
+       console.error("Error adding to list:", error);
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   if (!placeId) return null;
+ 
+   // For now, we'll show a simple dialog. In a real implementation,
+   // you'd fetch the place details from Google Places API or use the saved data
+   const placeData = savedPlace?.data || {};
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}&gt;
+       &lt;DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto"&gt;
+         &lt;DialogHeader&gt;
+           &lt;DialogTitle&gt;
+             {placeData.displayName?.text || "Place Details"}
+           &lt;/DialogTitle&gt;
+           &lt;DialogDescription&gt;
+             {placeData.formattedAddress || "Loading place details..."}
+           &lt;/DialogDescription&gt;
+         &lt;/DialogHeader&gt;
+ 
+         &lt;div className="space-y-4 mt-4"&gt;
+           {/* Rating */}
+           {placeData.rating &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+               &lt;Star className="h-5 w-5 fill-yellow-400 text-yellow-400" /&gt;
+               &lt;span className="font-semibold"&gt;{placeData.rating}&lt;/span&gt;
+               {placeData.userRatingCount &amp;&amp; (
+                 &lt;span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground"&gt;
+                   ({placeData.userRatingCount} reviews)
+                 &lt;/span&gt;
+               )}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Price Level */}
+           {placeData.priceLevel &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;Badge variant="secondary"&gt;
+                 {"$".repeat(placeData.priceLevel)}
+               &lt;/Badge&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Types */}
+           {placeData.types &amp;&amp; placeData.types.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2"&gt;
+               {placeData.types.slice(0, 5).map((type: string) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;Badge key={type} variant="outline"&gt;
+                   {type.replace(/_/g, " ")}
+                 &lt;/Badge&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Address */}
+           {placeData.formattedAddress &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="flex items-start gap-2"&gt;
+               &lt;MapPin className="h-5 w-5 mt-0.5 text-muted-foreground" /&gt;
+               &lt;span&gt;{placeData.formattedAddress}&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Phone */}
+           {placeData.nationalPhoneNumber &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+               &lt;Phone className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" /&gt;
+               &lt;span&gt;{placeData.nationalPhoneNumber}&lt;/span&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Website */}
+           {placeData.websiteUri &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="flex items-center gap-2"&gt;
+               &lt;Globe className="h-5 w-5 text-muted-foreground" /&gt;
+               &lt;a
+                 href={placeData.websiteUri}
+                 target="_blank"
+                 rel="noopener noreferrer"
+                 className="text-blue-600 hover:underline"
+               &gt;
+                 Visit Website
+               &lt;/a&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Opening Hours */}
+           {placeData.currentOpeningHours &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="flex items-start gap-2"&gt;
+               &lt;Clock className="h-5 w-5 mt-0.5 text-muted-foreground" /&gt;
+               &lt;div&gt;
+                 &lt;p className="font-semibold mb-1"&gt;Opening Hours&lt;/p&gt;
+                 {placeData.currentOpeningHours.weekdayDescriptions?.map(
+                   (desc: string, i: number) =&gt; (
+                     &lt;p key={i} className="text-sm"&gt;
+                       {desc}
+                     &lt;/p&gt;
+                   )
+                 )}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Photos */}
+           {placeData.photos &amp;&amp; placeData.photos.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div&gt;
+               &lt;p className="font-semibold mb-2"&gt;Photos&lt;/p&gt;
+               &lt;div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2"&gt;
+                 {placeData.photos.slice(0, 4).map((photo: any, i: number) =&gt; (
+                   &lt;img
+                     key={i}
+                     src={photo.uri || photo.name}
+                     alt={&#96;Photo ${i + 1}&#96;}
+                     className="w-full h-32 object-cover rounded-md"
+                   /&gt;
+                 ))}
+               &lt;/div&gt;
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+ 
+           {/* Actions */}
+           &lt;div className="flex flex-col gap-3 pt-4 border-t"&gt;
+             {savedPlace ? (
+               &lt;&gt;
+                 &lt;Button variant="destructive" onClick={handleRemove} disabled={saving}&gt;
+                   Remove from Saved Places
+                 &lt;/Button&gt;
+                 {userLists &amp;&amp; userLists.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+                   &lt;div className="flex gap-2"&gt;
+                     &lt;Select value={selectedListId} onValueChange={setSelectedListId}&gt;
+                       &lt;SelectTrigger&gt;
+                         &lt;SelectValue placeholder="Add to list..." /&gt;
+                       &lt;/SelectTrigger&gt;
+                       &lt;SelectContent&gt;
+                         {userLists.map((list) =&gt; (
+                           &lt;SelectItem key={list._id} value={list._id}&gt;
+                             {list.name}
+                           &lt;/SelectItem&gt;
+                         ))}
+                       &lt;/SelectContent&gt;
+                     &lt;/Select&gt;
+                     &lt;Button
+                       onClick={handleAddToList}
+                       disabled={!selectedListId}
+                     &gt;
+                       Add
+                     &lt;/Button&gt;
+                   &lt;/div&gt;
+                 )}
+               &lt;/&gt;
+             ) : (
+               &lt;Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={saving}&gt;
+                 {saving ? "Saving..." : "Save to App"}
+               &lt;/Button&gt;
+             )}
+           &lt;/div&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/DialogContent&gt;
+     &lt;/Dialog&gt;
+   );
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
+ import { APIProvider, Map, Marker, useMap } from "@vis.gl/react-google-maps";
+ import { useQuery } from "convex/react";
+ import { api } from "../../convex/_generated/api";
+ import { PlaceDetailsDialog } from "./PlaceDetailsDialog";
+ 
+ const API_KEY = import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY || "";
+ 
+ function MapContent() {
+   const [selectedPlaceId, setSelectedPlaceId] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
+   const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
+   const userPlaces = useQuery(api.places.getUserPlaces);
+   const map = useMap();
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (map &amp;&amp; userPlaces &amp;&amp; userPlaces.length &gt; 0) {
+       // Fit bounds to show all markers
+       const bounds = new google.maps.LatLngBounds();
+       userPlaces.forEach((place) =&gt; {
+         const location = place.data?.location;
+         if (location?.latitude &amp;&amp; location?.longitude) {
+           bounds.extend({
+             lat: location.latitude,
+             lng: location.longitude,
+           });
+         }
+       });
+       if (!bounds.isEmpty()) {
+         map.fitBounds(bounds);
+       }
+     }
+   }, [map, userPlaces]);
+ 
+   if (!userPlaces) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center"&gt;
+         &lt;p&gt;Loading places...&lt;/p&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;&gt;
+       &lt;div className="w-full h-full relative"&gt;
+         {userPlaces.map((place) =&gt; {
+           const location = place.data?.location;
+           if (!location?.latitude || !location?.longitude) return null;
+ 
+           return (
+             &lt;Marker
+               key={place._id}
+               position={{
+                 lat: location.latitude,
+                 lng: location.longitude,
+               }}
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setSelectedPlaceId(place.googlePlaceId);
+                 setDialogOpen(true);
+               }}
+               title={place.data?.displayName?.text || "Place"}
+             /&gt;
+           );
+         })}
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;PlaceDetailsDialog
+         placeId={selectedPlaceId}
+         open={dialogOpen}
+         onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
+         onPlaceSaved={() =&gt; {
+           // Refetch places
+         }}
+       /&gt;
+     &lt;/&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
+ export default function MapComponent() {
+   if (!API_KEY) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center bg-gray-100"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="text-center p-8"&gt;
+           &lt;p className="text-lg font-semibold mb-2"&gt;Google Maps API Key Required&lt;/p&gt;
+           &lt;p className="text-sm text-gray-600"&gt;
+             Please set VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY in your environment variables
+           &lt;/p&gt;
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;APIProvider apiKey={API_KEY}&gt;
+       &lt;div className="w-full h-full"&gt;
+         &lt;Map
+           defaultCenter={{ lat: 18.7883, lng: 98.9853 }} // Chiang Mai default
+           defaultZoom={13}
+           mapId="gmapsplus-map"
+           fullscreenControl={false}
+           streetViewControl={false}
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,135 @@
- 
+ import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
+ 
+ interface WheelItem {
+   id: string;
+   label: string;
+ }
+ 
+ interface WheelProps {
+   items: WheelItem[];
+   isSpinning: boolean;
+   onSpinComplete?: (item: WheelItem) =&gt; void;
+ }
+ 
+ export function Wheel({ items, isSpinning, onSpinComplete }: WheelProps) {
+   const canvasRef = useRef&lt;HTMLCanvasElement&gt;(null);
+   const [rotation, setRotation] = useState(0);
+   const animationRef = useRef&lt;number&gt;();
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (!canvasRef.current || items.length === 0) return;
+ 
+     const canvas = canvasRef.current;
+     const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
+     if (!ctx) return;
+ 
+     const size = Math.min(400, window.innerWidth - 64);
+     canvas.width = size;
+     canvas.height = size;
+     const centerX = size / 2;
+     const centerY = size / 2;
+     const radius = size / 2 - 20;
+ 
+     const drawWheel = (currentRotation: number) =&gt; {
+       ctx.clearRect(0, 0, size, size);
+ 
+       const anglePerItem = (2 * Math.PI) / items.length;
+ 
+       items.forEach((item, index) =&gt; {
+         const startAngle = index * anglePerItem + currentRotation;
+         const endAngle = (index + 1) * anglePerItem + currentRotation;
+ 
+         // Alternate colors
+         ctx.fillStyle = index % 2 === 0 ? "#a855f7" : "#ec4899";
+         ctx.beginPath();
+         ctx.moveTo(centerX, centerY);
+         ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, radius, startAngle, endAngle);
+         ctx.closePath();
+         ctx.fill();
+ 
+         // Draw text
+         ctx.save();
+         ctx.translate(centerX, centerY);
+         ctx.rotate(startAngle + anglePerItem / 2);
+         ctx.textAlign = "left";
+         ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
+         ctx.fillStyle = "white";
+         ctx.font = "bold 14px Arial";
+         const text = item.label.length &gt; 15 ? item.label.substring(0, 15) + "..." : item.label;
+         ctx.fillText(text, radius * 0.6, 0);
+         ctx.restore();
+       });
+ 
+       // Draw center circle
+       ctx.fillStyle = "#3b82f6";
+       ctx.beginPath();
+       ctx.arc(centerX, centerY, 30, 0, 2 * Math.PI);
+       ctx.fill();
+ 
+       // Draw pointer
+       ctx.fillStyle = "#10b981";
+       ctx.beginPath();
+       ctx.moveTo(centerX, centerY - radius - 10);
+       ctx.lineTo(centerX - 10, centerY - radius);
+       ctx.lineTo(centerX + 10, centerY - radius);
+       ctx.closePath();
+       ctx.fill();
+     };
+ 
+     if (isSpinning) {
+       let currentRotation = rotation;
+       const targetRotation = rotation + 4 * Math.PI + Math.random() * 2 * Math.PI;
+       const startTime = Date.now();
+       const duration = 2000;
+ 
+       const animate = () =&gt; {
+         const elapsed = Date.now() - startTime;
+         const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
+         const easeOut = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
+         currentRotation = rotation + (targetRotation - rotation) * easeOut;
+         setRotation(currentRotation);
+         drawWheel(currentRotation);
+ 
+         if (progress &lt; 1) {
+           animationRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(animate);
+         } else {
+           // Determine which item was selected
+           const normalizedRotation = ((currentRotation % (2 * Math.PI)) + 2 * Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI);
+           const anglePerItem = (2 * Math.PI) / items.length;
+           const pointerAngle = (3 * Math.PI) / 2; // Pointer is at top
+           let selectedIndex = Math.floor((pointerAngle - normalizedRotation + 2 * Math.PI) % (2 * Math.PI) / anglePerItem);
+           selectedIndex = items.length - 1 - selectedIndex;
+           if (selectedIndex &lt; 0) selectedIndex = 0;
+           if (selectedIndex &gt;= items.length) selectedIndex = items.length - 1;
+           
+           onSpinComplete?.(items[selectedIndex]);
+         }
+       };
+ 
+       animate();
+     } else {
+       drawWheel(rotation);
+     }
+ 
+     return () =&gt; {
+       if (animationRef.current) {
+         cancelAnimationFrame(animationRef.current);
+       }
+     };
+   }, [items, isSpinning, rotation, onSpinComplete]);
+ 
+   if (items.length === 0) {
+     return (
+       &lt;div className="w-full h-96 flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground"&gt;
+         No places selected
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+     );
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;div className="flex justify-center"&gt;
+       &lt;canvas ref={canvasRef} className="max-w-full" /&gt;
+     &lt;/div&gt;
+   );
+ }
+ 
```

</details>

</tool-use>

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,126 @@

+ import { useState, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
+ import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
+ import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
+ import { Search, X } from "lucide-react";
+ import { useLoadScript } from "@vis.gl/react-google-maps";
+ import { PlaceDetailsDialog } from "./PlaceDetailsDialog";
+ 
+ const API_KEY = import.meta.env.VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY || "";
+ 
+ export function PlaceSearch() {
+   const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState("");
+   const [predictions, setPredictions] = useState&lt;any[]&gt;([]);
+   const [showPredictions, setShowPredictions] = useState(false);
+   const [selectedPlaceId, setSelectedPlaceId] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);
+   const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
+   const inputRef = useRef&lt;HTMLInputElement&gt;(null);
+   const autocompleteServiceRef = useRef&lt;google.maps.places.AutocompleteService | null&gt;(null);
+   const placesServiceRef = useRef&lt;google.maps.places.PlacesService | null&gt;(null);
+ 
+   const { isLoaded } = useLoadScript({
+     googleMapsApiKey: API_KEY,
+     libraries: ["places"],
+   });
+ 
+   useEffect(() =&gt; {
+     if (isLoaded &amp;&amp; window.google) {
+       autocompleteServiceRef.current = new google.maps.places.AutocompleteService();
+     }
+   }, [isLoaded]);
+ 
+   const handleSearch = (query: string) =&gt; {
+     setSearchQuery(query);
+     if (!query.trim() || !autocompleteServiceRef.current) {
+       setPredictions([]);
+       setShowPredictions(false);
+       return;
+     }
+ 
+     autocompleteServiceRef.current.getPlacePredictions(
+       {
+         input: query,
+         types: ["establishment"],
+       },
+       (predictions, status) =&gt; {
+         if (status === google.maps.places.PlacesServiceStatus.OK &amp;&amp; predictions) {
+           setPredictions(predictions);
+           setShowPredictions(true);
+         } else {
+           setPredictions([]);
+           setShowPredictions(false);
+         }
+       }
+     );
+   };
+ 
+   const handleSelectPlace = (placeId: string) =&gt; {
+     setSelectedPlaceId(placeId);
+     setSearchQuery("");
+     setPredictions([]);
+     setShowPredictions(false);
+     setDialogOpen(true);
+   };
+ 
+   if (!isLoaded) {
+     return null;
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     &lt;&gt;
+       &lt;div className="absolute top-4 left-4 z-10 w-full max-w-md"&gt;
+         &lt;div className="relative"&gt;
+           &lt;Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" /&gt;
+           &lt;Input
+             ref={inputRef}
+             type="text"
+             placeholder="Search for places..."
+             value={searchQuery}
+             onChange={(e) =&gt; handleSearch(e.target.value)}
+             onFocus={() =&gt; {
+               if (predictions.length &gt; 0) {
+                 setShowPredictions(true);
+               }
+             }}
+             className="pl-10 pr-10"
+           /&gt;
+           {searchQuery &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;Button
+               variant="ghost"
+               size="icon"
+               className="absolute right-1 top-1/2 transform -translate-y-1/2 h-8 w-8"
+               onClick={() =&gt; {
+                 setSearchQuery("");
+                 setPredictions([]);
+                 setShowPredictions(false);
+               }}
+             &gt;
+               &lt;X className="h-4 w-4" /&gt;
+             &lt;/Button&gt;
+           )}
+           {showPredictions &amp;&amp; predictions.length &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; (
+             &lt;div className="absolute top-full left-0 right-0 mt-1 bg-background border rounded-md shadow-lg max-h-60 overflow-y-auto z-20"&gt;
+               {predictions.map((prediction) =&gt; (
+                 &lt;button
+                   key={prediction.place_id}
+                   className="w-full text-left px-4 py-2 hover:bg-muted cursor-pointer"
+                   onClick={() =&gt; handleSelectPlace(prediction.place_id)}
+                 &gt;
+                   &lt;div className="font-medium"&gt;{prediction.description}&lt;/div&gt;
+                 &lt;/button&gt;
+               ))}
+             &lt;/div&gt;
+           )}
+         &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;/div&gt;
+       &lt;PlaceDetailsDialog
+         placeId={selectedPlaceId}
+         open={dialogOpen}
+         onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
+         onPlaceSaved={() =&gt; {
+           setSelectedPlaceId(null);
+         }}
+       /&gt;
+     &lt;/&gt;
+   );
+ }
+
```

## Summary

Implemented GMapsPlus with the following:

### Completed features

1. **Database schema** (`convex/schema.ts`)
   - `places` table (shared, no user ownership)
   - `userPlaces` junction table
   - `lists`, `listPlaces`, `sharedLists` tables
   - Indexes configured

2. **Backend functions**
   - `convex/googlePlaces.ts` - Fetches place details with `fieldMask: "*"`
   - `convex/places.ts` - Save/get/remove/search places (checks if place exists before API call)
   - `convex/lists.ts` - List CRUD, sharing, add/remove places

3. **UI components (Shadcn UI)**
   - Button, Card, Dialog, Input, Select, Checkbox, Badge, Tabs, Sheet, Avatar

4. **Pages**
   - Landing page with features
   - Auth page (sign in/sign up)
   - Map page with Google Maps integration and place search
   - Places list page (table/card views with filtering)
   - Lists page (create/manage lists)
   - List details page (view/edit lists, add/remove places)
   - Wheel of Places page (spinning wheel component)
   - Shared lists page

5. **Components**
   - Navigation with user info
   - Map component with markers
   - PlaceDetailsDialog (save/unsave, add to lists)
   - PlaceSearch (autocomplete search)
   - Wheel component (canvas-based spinning wheel)

6. **Routing**
   - React Router with protected routes
   - Landing → Auth → App flow

### Next steps

1. Set environment variables:
   - `VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY` (frontend)
   - `GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY` (Convex backend)

2. Run the app:
   ```bash
   npm run dev
   ```

The app checks if a place exists in the database before calling the Google Places API, reducing API costs. All places are stored as shared entities, and users link to them via the `userPlaces` junction table.

TypeScript check passed. Summary of fixes:

## Fixed TypeScript Errors

1. **`convex/places.ts`**:
   - Removed `ctx.runAction()` call (mutations can't call actions)
   - Added return type annotation to `handler`
   - Updated `savePlace` to accept optional `placeData` parameter
   - Client now fetches place data via action, then passes it to the mutation

2. **Client-side updates**:
   - Updated `PlaceDetailsDialog` to fetch place data using `useAction` before saving
   - Fixed floating promise warnings by adding `void` operators
   - Fixed empty interface by changing to type alias
   - Removed unused imports

3. **ESLint fixes**:
   - Added `void` operators for promise-returning onClick handlers
   - Removed unused variables
   - Fixed type errors

The app should now compile without TypeScript errors. The flow is:
1. User searches/selects a place → `PlaceDetailsDialog` opens
2. If place not saved → fetch via `fetchPlaceDetails` action
3. Save place → call `savePlace` mutation with the fetched data
4. If place already exists in DB → mutation just creates userPlaces link

You can now run `npm run dev` and the project should work.

Fixed the issue:

1. Removed `useLoadScript` — it's not exported from `@vis.gl/react-google-maps`.
2. Used `useMapsLibrary("places")` — works with the `APIProvider` context.
3. Moved `PlaceSearch` inside the `APIProvider` — it needs to be within the provider to access the Google Maps API.
4. Added `libraries={["places"]}` to `APIProvider` — ensures the Places library is loaded.

The `PlaceSearch` component now uses `useMapsLibrary` to access the Places library from the `APIProvider` context, which is the correct approach for `@vis.gl/react-google-maps`.

The error should be resolved. Refresh your browser and the search should work.

Fixed the visibility issues:

1. **Updated CSS** — Switched from HSL CSS variables to hex colors that Tailwind v4 recognizes.

2. **Updated Landing page** — Added explicit Tailwind color classes:
   - Header with white/dark background
   - Text colors (gray-900 for headings, gray-600 for descriptions)
   - Buttons with gray-900/white backgrounds
   - Cards with proper borders and backgrounds

3. **Updated Auth page** — Added explicit colors:
   - Card with white/dark background and border
   - Input fields with visible borders and text
   - Button with proper contrast
   - Text colors for all elements

4. **Updated Button component** — Replaced CSS variable-based colors with explicit Tailwind classes that work in light and dark modes.

Elements should now be visible with proper contrast. Refresh your browser to see the changes. The pages use standard Tailwind colors that work regardless of CSS variable configuration.
